ActorTalk: A Gray Raven flag? Is this... official merchandise?
Apparently. I can't imagine who'd be impulsive enough to buy one. It'll just end up as worthless junk taking up space in their dorm.
...Are you genuinely asking, or are you just playing dumb? They used to sell flags of other squads.
Decoration. A collector's item. A statement of aspiration, like what kind of commandant you want to be.
Each squad represented a different path to excellence. Back in the day, some cadets practically brawled over the flags of a distinguished squad.
That sounds dangerous... I hope no one was hurt.
Please. It was just posturing among over-eager recruits. Nothing consequential.
Did they always sell the Gray Raven flags?
